name: Kisdorog (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kisdorog: a blue shield with a yellow lion, with a helm, a lion crest and red, green and grey mantling, above a yellow scroll inscribed KISDOROG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kisdorog arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
